Departed Pearl in Company with THRESHER and PIRANHA as part of Coordinated Attack Group (GUARDFISH THRESHER PIRANHA and APOGON) known as Micky Finns with Captain W. V. O'Regan in GUARDFISH (port position as PARCHE Patrol 1)
Moored to GABILAN alongside HOLLAND at Midway. Replenished fuel and fresh water (port position as PARCHE Patrol 1)
Departed Midway with plane escort; 1735 Thresher returned to Midway for repairs (port position as PARCHE Patrol 1)
Rendezvous with APOGON; 0445 passed patrol instructions via line and empty 4in shell container; 0446 set course for area (no position typed)
Micky Finns commenced search for downed aviator; 0941 sighted Pajaros Island bearing 177 T distant 30 miles; 1935 secured search (no position typed)
Entered Area (no position typed)
Sighted Y'Ami Island of Batan Group (no position typed)
Dove on days patrol line across Bashi Channel; sampans and fishing boats let pass (no position typed)
Received contact report from Piranha 110 miles to eastward by Dead Reckoning. No fix for 36 hours. 0402 changed course to intercept (no position typed)

SJ contact 347 T 22000 yards; 2145 convoy had changed base course from 195 T to 270 T at dark; 2220 base course 210 T; 2235 convoy consists of 10 ships with three escorts definitely located (no position typed)
Received contact report from Thresher. 2248 c/c and speed to intercept (no position typed)

Ship contact #2. SJ Radar bearing 195°T, range 30,000 yards. Commenced tracking and making end around to port of convoy. Convoy consists of nine large ships and at least five escorts (no position typed)
0001 made sight contact; 0228 Apogon dove for attack; 0255 in position ahead, half moon too bright for surface attack; 0308 heard ten explosions - two sounded like torpedoes (no position typed)
Dove for attack. Convoy bearing 016°T, range 17,500 yards... Base course since 2245(I) 197°T, speed of advance 10.6 knots (no position typed)
0418 realized targets have changed base course to about 165°T; 0431 least torpedo run to nearest target 3,800 yards. Did not fire... A rotten performance from an ideal position (no position typed)

0512 surfaced opening range to east ward; 0521 plane contact #8, SJ radar, dove; 0547 surfaced, convoy bearing 180°T 26,000 yards; 0613 plane contact #9, sighted plane from bridge, dove (no position typed)
0813 masts of two ships in sight through #1 periscope on south easterly course; 0848 two distant explosions. Believed torpedo (Piranha's attack?) (no position typed)
Sighted plane. No contact with convoy... Convoy had disappeared; probably gone west through Babuyan Channel after Piranha's attack (no position typed)
Discontinued search; reversed course proceeding back to area. 2155 torpedo in racks made hot run; 2316 exchanged SJ signals with Piranha (no position typed)
Thresher joined formation. 0605 dove; 1952 surfaced (no position typed)
Surfaced. Commenced passage through Balingtang Channel (as typed). 2016 SJ out of commission (no position typed)
Formed scouting line; searching to south for reported convoy. 0331 SJ back in commission (no position typed)

2000 commenced search to N.E.; 2300 changed course to N.W. Piranha did not receive message changing direction of search... The Piranha scouts to the northeast; while Guardfish and Thresher scout to the northwest (no position typed)

First of six hits in four ships. The Tanker was loaded with gas and blew up immediately... the third ship in line, an AK, broke in two in the middle and sank, and the fourth ship in line went down bow first... withheld fire as other ships were seen to scatter in all directions (no position typed)
Commenced tracking one large ship. An escort dropping depth charges on far side of convoy. 0038 in good position on starboard bow of AK at 2,500 yards (no position typed)
Two hits. Pulled clear as we had an escort within 2,600 yards... Target leaned over on its starboard side and disappeared from sight and SJ screen at 7,700 yards (no position typed)
The burning ship gave up with one final explosion and disappeared. 0136 commenced tracking another target; 0212 in position ahead of new target (no position typed)
After Attack 4: believed this ship sank but only damage is claimed... secured from battle stations and pulled clear to northward on four engines (no position typed)
Large explosion and flare up bearing 332°T, 25-30 miles distant. (Thresher busy?) 0405 sighted searchlight sweeping horizon bearing 280°T (no position typed)
0603 dove for the day; 0606 heard echo-ranging to port; 0613 first of string of 21 depth charges on port side (no position typed)
